provenance: Original literal synthetic inputs in workloads.py and model_workloads.rs. Apache-2.0. No manuscript values, external datasets or model weights.

89.task: Exact two-coordinate median of five radius-four integer updates
89.observer: The joint prover sees the ordered updates. The verifier receives the blinded commitment, aggregate and proof.
89.privacy_unit: One complete two-coordinate client update under fixed roster replacement adjacency
89.release: Deterministic median. No privacy mechanism. Public-reference cosine is an independent reference check.

90.task: Width-two, one-feature ReLU forward pass and separate one-sample SGD relation
90.observer: The joint prover sees features, label and weights. The verifier sees the commitment and the score or all four updated weights.
90.privacy_unit: One synthetic entity and its labeled example
90.release: Inference score or complete post-update model. No noise, composition claim or private training system.

91.task: Frozen synthetic bigram head with one learned rank-one margin correction, plus a separate role-based exact-match retrieval fixture
91.observer: The adaptation harness sees training and holdout tokens. The retrieval host sees queries, roles, documents and match sets. The caller receives permitted document IDs.
91.privacy_unit: One example entity for adaptation; one document and authorization entry for retrieval
91.release: Public synthetic metrics only. No raw real prompts, retrieved text, embeddings or generations. Authorization is a local allow-list; retrieval privacy and completeness are unproved.

92.task: Separate capped preference vote, clipped teacher-logit cohort transfer, and generated canary audit
92.observer: The preference aggregator sees votes. The curator sees teacher logits and generated tokens. A student receives clipped cohort means for groups of at least two.
92.privacy_unit: One voter for preference; one teacher example for distillation or generation
92.release: Vote sign, clipped cohort mean, or threshold-selected token. Group size and clipping provide no DP claim. The generation check finds a deliberately copied canary.

93.task: Binary paired versus unpaired correspondence with a changed alignment and one absent modality
93.observer: Silos see their own values. The authorized fixture joiner sees exact pair IDs and both modalities. The unpaired evaluator sees only marginals.
93.privacy_unit: One whole pair or one unpaired entity
93.release: Only synthetic correctness counts. Pair IDs are explicit authorization inputs. Negative sampling and embeddings are unused.

94.task: Two-silo recommendation with fixed public item embeddings, bounded user edges and exact top-one ranking
94.observer: The synthetic ranker sees authorized support edges and shared item vocabulary. Ground-truth edges remain with the evaluator.
94.privacy_unit: One whole user capped at two edges; node and edge privacy are different units
94.release: Public synthetic aggregate ranking metrics only. No cross-silo user join. No proof of embeddings, negative sampling, aggregation, completeness or utility.

95.task: Entity-disjoint seasonal forecast with nonoverlapping event-time evaluation windows and modeled device budgets
95.observer: A synthetic client holds its time series. The simulation observes completion, admission, payload size and timing. It reports per-source error.
95.release: Synthetic forecasts and counters. Host CPU time is measured; edge availability, memory, network latency and coverage are modeled.
